categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies src/rest.cpp and test/functional/interface_rest.py.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where POST requests to `/rest/getutxos` return incorrect results due to payload misalignment. As noted in the description, 'GET finds the unspent output, but POST incorrectly reports no hit' because streaming into `DataStream` prepended a string length prefix, directly violating returned data correctness for the endpoint.
